title: Fix Missing kernelGeometry Export in Brep Js
description: Fix runtime error: geometry/brep/js/index.ts does not export kernelGeometry, solidRef, EdgeCurve, ArcPlaneFrame, EdgeGroup, EdgeInfo, FaceInfo that cad/js/core imports.
summary: Restored missing brep contracts in @semio-tech/geometry-brep-js: kernelGeometry namespace, solidRef, EdgeCurve, ArcPlaneFrame, EdgeGroup, FaceInfo, EdgeInfo, and full MeshTransfer shape. Cad core imports these from the geometry bundle; the refactor had updated imports without adding the exports.
